inputs_sent.prompt: Keep everything in image 1 exactly as it is: the same room, the same camera position and framing, the same light, the lit phone on the bedside table, and the same man asleep in the bed under the duvet, who has not moved. Add one new element: a double of the sleeping man, made of light, has sat up out of his sleeping body. His head, shoulders, chest and arms are upright above the middle of the bed, and from the waist down he is still merged with the sleeper's body under the duvet: he has not left the bed and his legs cannot be seen. His shoulders are turned toward the head of the bed; he leans forward a little, and with one outstretched hand he holds the top edge of the duvet at the sleeper's shoulder: he has just gently pulled it up to cover him. The double is an exact copy of the man shown in image 2 and image 3, who is also the man asleep in the bed: the same face, the same short dark hair and trimmed beard, the same warm medium-brown skin and the same dark charcoal T-shirt. His face and skin keep their own natural brown colour and his clothes keep their own dark colours; only the light itself is pale mint-green (#b7f4cf). He is lit from within: a soft core of mint light glows inside his chest and shines out through his body, which has soft edges and no hard drawn outline. He is more solid than before, only faintly see-through at the arms and the waist. Many hair-thin threads of mint light, as fine as spun glass, still join his chest and back to the sleeper's chest, with tiny beads of light on them. He looks down at the sleeper's face with a calm, kind expression and closed lips; he does not look at the camera. His glow falls softly on the duvet, the pillow and the sleeper's face. He looks friendly, gentle and capable, never ghostly or frightening. There are exactly two figures in the room: one solid and asleep in the bed, one made of light. Photorealistic, like a frame from a premium advertising film. Nothing written anywhere.
